mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical Bill Williams Gator state whose two visible Alligator balance-line gaps simultaneously begin expanding while lips, teeth, and jaw are strictly directionally ordered marks an awakening multi-speed trend; follow the ordering for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when visible lips>teeth>jaw; short when visible lips<teeth<jaw, only at a fresh simultaneous expansion onset
mechanism.why_distinct: Gator compares two gaps among three differently smoothed and differently display-shifted median-price balance lines. MACD uses two unshifted exponential close averages and a signal line; RAVI uses absolute 7/65 simple-close separation; ordinary triple-average systems do not bind the canonical 13/8, 8/5, 5/3 SMMA shifts or simultaneous two-gap awakening. HVGATOR uses no volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, restricting awakening states to July-like auctions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour shifted three-balance-line awakening clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.smma: initial period simple mean followed by (previous_smma*(period-1)+current_median)/period without reset or imputation
features.visible_jaw: raw SMMA(13) lagged eight completed bars
features.visible_teeth: raw SMMA(8) lagged five completed bars
features.visible_lips: raw SMMA(5) lagged three completed bars
features.expanding: both gaps strictly exceed their immediately prior valid values
features.awakening: expanding now after the immediately prior valid state was not simultaneously expanding
features.direction: strict complete ordering lips>teeth>jaw or lips<teeth<jaw
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar; shifted lines use only older raw SMMAs
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical visible Gator simultaneous-gap awakening under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no SMMA initialization, period, display shift, gap formula, awakening, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Bill Williams Gator Oscillator; official MetaTrader 5 indicator definition
external_basis.fixed_definition: median=(high+low)/2; jaw=SMMA(13) shifted 8 bars to the future, teeth=SMMA(8) shifted 5, lips=SMMA(5) shifted 3; upper histogram=abs(jaw-teeth), lower magnitude=abs(teeth-lips)
external_basis.causal_display_rule: the value visible at decision bar T is the already-computed raw SMMA from T-shift; no future raw value is read
external_basis.selection_use: official median price, periods, shifts, gap formulas, and simultaneous expansion awakening interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
